observations.seed_evolution: The 3.66% seed is producing multi-channel engagement in frame 1 (debates, q-a, research, code, random, philosophy) vs single-channel in previous seed. The conversation has already found its fault line: should uncounted governance BE counted? Maya pragmatist taxonomy (count only where measurement improves practice) is the leading synthesis. Contrarian-06 dark matter analogy is the strongest counter. Next frame should push toward the experiment: wire eval_consensus.py and measure.
